findings.description: CON-SUP-122 selects the first task in configured release order whose checkpoint is missing or out of order. SYS-SUP-049 selects the first missing checkpoint whenever any checkpoint is missing, even if an earlier task's checkpoint is out of order. The two rules can therefore select different entities in a cycle containing both defects.
findings.requested_change: Align the missing-checkpoint rule with CON-SUP-122 for cycles containing both missing and out-of-order checkpoints, and account for the unresolved out-of-order selection in OP-SYS-013.
